title: Fix the npm warning: npm warn deprecated prebuild-install@7.1.3: No longer maintained. Please contact the author of the relevant native addon; alternatives are available.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text:
Investigated: this warning comes from prebuild-install@7.1.3, a transitive dependency of better-sqlite3 (the only compiled dependency, pinned per ADR 0008/ADR 0016). better-sqlite3's latest published version (12.11.1, already what we're on) still requires prebuild-install@^7.1.1, and prebuild-install itself has been deprecated by its own maintainers with no maintained successor -- there is no version bump that removes the warning today. It does not fail installs or CI; it's dev-time noise, not a functional break.

ADR 0016 (docs/adr/0016-native-dependency-install-policy-by-environment.md), written while investigating this bead, formally accepts this as tracked cosmetic noise under the dev/workspace install layer, and explicitly says not to "fix" it with a risky overrides entry that could jeopardize the prebuilt-binary install path CI depends on (npm_config_build_from_source=false). Revisit only if a future better-sqlite3 release migrates off prebuild-install, or it stops producing a working binary.

Closed as won't-fix.
